correctness.rationale: For any r>=2,n>=2r+1, rotating coordinates converts each merge letter at cumulative rotation t to an occupied timestamp update: add t, replace t-r by t, or no change. With fewer than 2r rotations each of r residue chains can have at most one hole, even with ineffective b letters. At 2r rotations equality requires r+1 effective merges at an independent set of timestamp positions; graph = path of length two plus r-1 independent edges, giving precisely 2^(r-1) words. Shorter thresholds use mandatory alternating b and a. Independent subset-BFS and constructive verification passed 130 rank/count cases plus 6,138 witnesses; finite checks are supportive only.

value.rationale: Exact rank-vs-time threshold classification for a natural two-parameter synchronizing-family subproblem, with an abrupt r+2 letter jump and 2^(r-1) optimizers where all earlier optimizers are unique. This shows a meaningful structural branching transition in shortest compressing words, rather than an isolated numerical improvement. The independent-set model is a reusable representation of all first-bottleneck labels.
